title: Vrio Corp
description: vriocorp.com Vrio Corp is a Latin American telecommunications and media company spun off from AT&T in 2021, operating the DIRECTV and Sky satellite TV platforms across 10 countries with approximately 10 million subscribers and 4,000 plus employees. Headquartered in Miami with regional offices in Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Bogotá and Mexico City, it generates estimated revenue of 1.5 to 2 billion dollars annually. Its DIRECTV platform serves Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela while Sky operates in Brazil and Mexico. The company offers satellite TV packages, streaming through DIRECTV GO and Sky+ apps, cloud DVR and bundles with Disney+, HBO Max and Paramount+. Its sports portfolio includes ESPN, Fox Sports, Sky Sports and TyC Sports. As an independent entity it focuses on digital transformation, OTT growth and content partnerships across Latin America.
